roadmap.title: Weeping Creek Valley
roadmap.description: Play the opening region. Take the Weeping Creek Valley side tales from Yu'er and the Shadow Warden before you leave, make a manual save at the start and end of every region, and use the early weapons to pick up the easy combat achievements.

roadmap.title: Crimson Forest
roadmap.description: Finish Yu'er's healing tales and accept the tale from Lanlan before Bai Chilian falls, then pick up the Fanatic's Broken Blade, Outlaw Warblade and Iron Gauntlets achievements.

roadmap.title: Village of Lu
roadmap.description: Collect the five headbands for the Young Mistress tale before the final boss, return to Old Man Gen and Young Master Lan once the way to Pangzhen opens, and start the Firefly flower tale.

roadmap.title: Pangzhen
roadmap.description: Meet Myst, defeat Flame and Chang Hong, and finish the Flesh Lily tale; the Thunder Spear comes from this region.

roadmap.title: Mandate Encampment and Meigu Lake
roadmap.description: Clear the optional Mandate Encampment bosses and the Meigu Lake bosses, then upgrade a weapon and a Phantom Edge to level 30 and win the second You Loong fight.

roadmap.title: Mountain of Imprisonment and true-ending prep
roadmap.description: Finish every purple-icon tale that closes at Mirage Estate: the Firefly and lake tales, the Mountain of Imprisonment, the optional blade masters, the Acolyte masks and the Banyan trees, then solve the Green Serpent House lock.

roadmap.title: Mirage Estate
roadmap.description: Beat Yuding and Lei Dang, win the last Long Pillar for the Bastion of Mo Mask, hand in the last Quick Hand treasures, and temper your weapons.

roadmap.title: Mount Soulrend and clean-up
roadmap.description: Revisit the frozen Crimson Forest, finish the leftover collectibles, then pass the Last Chance bell and win the true ending.

achievements.description: Escape the Pursuers on the Main Road
achievements.summary: Get away from the pursuers on the main road in the opening.

steps.text: Play the opening until you get away from the pursuers chasing you down the @loc{main road}. It unlocks by itself.

achievements.description: Pass through the Outpost.
achievements.summary: Pass through the Outpost in Weeping Creek Valley.

steps.text: Follow the story through @loc{Weeping Creek Valley} and walk through the @loc{Outpost}.

achievements.description: Leave the cave behind the waterfall.
achievements.summary: Leave the cave behind the waterfall in Weeping Creek Valley.

steps.text: Keep following the story in @loc{Weeping Creek Valley} until you walk out of the cave behind the waterfall.

achievements.description: Unravel the illusion in Mirrorwood.
achievements.summary: Unravel the illusion in Mirrorwood in Crimson Forest.

steps.text: Cross @loc{Mirrorwood} and solve its mirror puzzles until the illusion clears. This comes just before @enemy{Bai Chilian}.

achievements.description: Leave Village of Lu for Pangzhen.
achievements.summary: Leave Village of Lu for Pangzhen.

guide.context: Old Man Gen's and Young Master Lan's tales must be handled before you step into Pangzhen.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Village of Lu}, open the sealed door that closes off the region, and go through into @loc{Pangzhen}.
Before you go through, return to @npc{Old Man Gen} and @npc{Young Master Lan} once the door is open. The steps are in their own achievements.

achievements.description: Visit the Order's tavern.
achievements.summary: Visit the Order's tavern in Pangzhen.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Pangzhen} until you enter the Order's underground tavern, where @npc{Myst} waits.

achievements.description: Solve the Serpent Head Lock puzzle inside the Green Serpent House.
achievements.summary: Solve the Serpent Head Lock puzzle inside the Green Serpent House.

guide.context: The lock at the rear of the Green Serpent House needs items from the Red, Black and White Serpent Houses in other regions.

steps.text: In @loc{Pangzhen}, have @npc{Lei Dang} repair the @item{Flaming Mane} at the Jingyang Hall Bell.

Use @item{Flaming Mane} to burn the branches at the @loc{Red Serpent House} in @loc{Crimson Forest} and the @loc{Black Serpent House} in @loc{Village of Lu}. Take the Loong Emblem pieces and the serpent items inside.
Use the Loong Emblem to open the @loc{White Serpent House} in @loc{Meigu Lake}, defeat @enemy{Heartpiercer}, and take the white serpent items.
Go to the @loc{Green Serpent House} in @loc{Pangzhen} and solve the Serpent Head Lock on the door at the back.

achievements.description: Investigate the Training Grounds.
achievements.summary: Investigate the Training Grounds in Mandate Encampment.

guide.context: Mandate Encampment is an optional region. The gate at the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Bell in Village of Lu opens with a key found in Pangzhen.

steps.text: Unlock the gate at the @loc{Mandate Encampment Outer Gate} Bell with the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key from @loc{Pangzhen}.
Go to the @loc{Training Grounds} in @loc{Mandate Encampment} and enter them.
Do not defeat the boss at the end of the Training Grounds yet. It would fail the tale Secrets of the Baishan Sect.

achievements.description: Reach the Realm of Mirage.
achievements.summary: Reach the Realm of Mirage.

steps.text: Advance through the story and explore each new area. This unlocks when you first arrive in the @loc{Realm of Mirage}.

achievements.description: Slash through the heart of the lake.
achievements.summary: Slash through the heart of the lake in the hidden Discordance realm.

guide.context: This is one stage of the lake tale and can unlock before the tale is finished.

steps.text: Get four Acolyte Masks: win the scarecrow fights in @loc{Village of Lu}, @loc{Pangzhen} and @loc{Meigu Lake}, and defeat @enemy{Acolyte Hansui} in the @loc{Crimson Manor}.

Repair the Illusory Pipa with @npc{Myst}, enter the @loc{Mountain of Imprisonment} and clear its Herald's Illusion portal to get the @item{Puppet's Tongue} and the @item{Crystal Puppet Eye [Yin]}. The @enemy{Puppet Scavenger} and @enemy{Acolyte Hansui} fight in the manor needs the tongue and drops the @item{Crystal Puppet Eye [Yang]}.
In the snowy west of @loc{Meigu Lake}, use the four masks on the mirror, cross the @loc{Phantom Illusionist Ruins} and defeat the @enemy{Blizzard Blademaster}.
Set both eyes in the red statue behind his arena, step into the hidden realm and beat the elders carrying out the ritual.

achievements.description: Pass through Mirage Estate.
achievements.summary: Pass through Mirage Estate.

guide.context: Entering Mirage Estate closes ten of the tales the true ending needs. Bloodline Awakening stays open until the final area.

steps.text: Finish the ten purple-icon tales listed under With Heart and Blood first.
Go into @loc{Mirage Estate} by way of the @loc{Green Serpent House} and push on to the end of the region.

achievements.description: Step into the snow and head for the cliff.
achievements.summary: Step into the snow at the start of Mount Soulrend and head for the cliff.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Mount Soulrend} and walk into the snow toward the cliff.

achievements.description: Reach the true ending.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with the true ending.

guide.context: The true ending needs every purple-icon tale in the journal; gold-icon quests are the main story. The game warns you when you enter Mirage Estate with purple tales open, and warns you again at the Last Chance bell even when all are done. After the ending a failed tale cannot be restarted, so keep a manual save before each point.

steps.text: Before entering @loc{Mirage Estate}, finish these tales: The Herald's Illusion, Deep in the Valley, Secrets at the Heart, Illusory Pipa, Crimson Manor, Pillars of Kunlun, Whence the Weeping, Allure of Vanity, Sha-Chi Powered Boat and Illusion of Inanis.
Defeat @enemy{Zhu Yuan} and @enemy{Bi Feng}. The true ending needs both.
Finish Bloodline Awakening before the final area by winning all five Long Pillar fights. The last pillar is in @loc{Mirage Estate}; the other four are listed under Phantom and Blade.
In @loc{Mount Soulrend}, pass the Last Chance bell and defeat @enemy{Leng Tu} and @enemy{Meng Hua}.
Go through the golden portal at the cliff top in @loc{Soulrend Cliff} and beat @enemy{Zho Shang}. The true ending then plays and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Defeat Axemaster Peng Meng.
achievements.summary: Defeat Axemaster Peng Meng.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Peng Meng} in the arena outside the Outpost in @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}. He is a required boss.

achievements.description: Defeat Hua, the Bride.
achievements.summary: Defeat Hua, the Bride, the optional boss in Weeping Creek Valley.

steps.text: Begin at the first-floor bell of the @loc{Valley Sha-Chi Tower}. Walk around to the back of the tower on its right side, drop through the hole in the ground and slide down the wooden ramp. At the bottom, follow the path to the left until it ends.
Defeat @enemy{Hua, Deadly Betrothed} and take the @item{Twin Flesh Lilies} from the altar in her arena.
steps.note: The lilies are needed for The Healer's Legacy.

achievements.description: Beat the Hunt, the Order's hunter.
achievements.summary: Beat the Hunt, the Order's hunter.

steps.text: Follow the story to the end of @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}, past the Sha-Chi Tower and the waterfall bridge, and defeat @enemy{the Hunt}.

achievements.description: Defeat Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic.
achievements.summary: Defeat Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hua Qianxiao} on the bridge at the start of @loc{Crimson Forest}. He is a required boss.

achievements.description: Take down Bai Chilian, the Lady of the Twin Serpents.
achievements.summary: Take down Bai Chilian, the Lady of the Twin Serpents.

guide.context: Her defeat ends several tales for good.

steps.text: Before the fight, give the Flesh Lily to @npc{Yu'er}, finish A Healer's Mercy, and accept Secrets of the Baishan Sect from @npc{Lanlan}.
Cross @loc{Mirrorwood} and beat @enemy{Bai Chilian}, who waits at the far end of @loc{Crimson Forest}.

achievements.description: Beat Mu Xiaokui, the Order's Young Mistress.
achievements.summary: Beat Mu Xiaokui, the Order's Young Mistress.

steps.text: Before you ride the lift up to the lakeside, finish the Young Mistress tale. Otherwise the last phase and the Fiend Saws are lost. See Delayed Blast.
Ride the lift and defeat @enemy{Mu Xiaokui} at the end of @loc{Village of Lu}.
steps.note: Pick up the Wild Oriole Sword on the dock and the chest by the tree before you take the lift out. You cannot come back.

achievements.description: Defeat Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster.
achievements.summary: Defeat Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster.

steps.text: Fight through the @loc{Lion Dance Hall} at the start of @loc{Pangzhen} and defeat @enemy{Flame}. He is a required boss.

achievements.description: Defeat the Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars.
achievements.summary: Beat the Seven-Stars Formation's Chief Disciple.

guide.context: Mandate Encampment is an optional region.

steps.text: Unlock the gate at the @loc{Mandate Encampment Outer Gate} Bell in @loc{Village of Lu} with the key from @loc{Pangzhen}.
Fight through the encampment to the middle of the region and defeat the @enemy{Chief Disciple}.
steps.note: If @enemy{Red, the Mysterious Swordswoman} is still alive, she joins in phase 2.

achievements.description: Defeat Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade.
achievements.summary: Defeat Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade.

guide.context: The Mountain of Imprisonment is an optional region. Entering needs the repaired Illusory Pipa.

steps.text: Collect the three Illusory Pipa pieces (from @enemy{Dusk, The Puppeteer} in Village of Lu, @enemy{Yubi} in Mandate Encampment and @enemy{Yan Qiansui} in Meigu Lake) and have @npc{Myst} repair it.
Enter the @loc{Mountain of Imprisonment} and follow the path to the shrine at the end.
Defeat @enemy{Huangxing}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Puppet Scavenger.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Puppet Scavenger.

guide.context: The fight needs the Puppet's Tongue, found in the Mountain of Imprisonment. Acolyte Hansui fights alongside.

steps.text: In @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}, head into the little cave to the right of the Long Pillar Overlook Bell. Lead the enemy with the explosive on his back to the metal cage in the middle so it blows the cage open.
Ride the elevator down to the @loc{Crimson Manor}, open the manor door with the @item{Puppet's Tongue} and go down to the @loc{Scavenger Pens} Bell.
Defeat the @enemy{Puppet Scavenger}.

achievements.description: Defeat Lei Dang, the Order's Envoy.
achievements.summary: Defeat Lei Dang, the Order's Envoy.

guide.context: Mirage Estate is the northern part of Pangzhen, entered through the Green Serpent House.

steps.text: Finish the ten purple-icon tales listed under With Heart and Blood before you enter.
Fight through @loc{Mirage Estate} and defeat @enemy{Lei Dang} at the end of the region. He is a required boss.

achievements.description: Defeat the Blizzard Blademaster.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Blizzard Blademaster.

steps.text: Get all four Acolyte Masks: the scarecrow fights in @loc{Village of Lu}, @loc{Pangzhen} and @loc{Meigu Lake}, and @enemy{Acolyte Hansui} in the @loc{Crimson Manor}.
In the snowy west of @loc{Meigu Lake}, use the four masks on the mirror and cross the @loc{Phantom Illusionist Ruins} to the end.
Defeat the @enemy{Blizzard Blademaster}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Saw and the Crusher.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Saw and the Crusher.

steps.text: Follow the path in @loc{Mount Soulrend} to @loc{The Giant's Lair} and defeat @enemy{the Saw and the Crusher}.

achievements.description: Defeat the final boss of the normal ending.
achievements.summary: Beat Meng Hua, the Blossom Veil's Merciful Lady.

guide.context: The Last Chance bell in Mount Soulrend is the point of no return: you cannot leave until the ending.

steps.text: Before you pass the Last Chance bell, finish the true-ending tales and make a manual save.
Pass the @loc{Last Chance} Bell and defeat @enemy{Leng Tu} and then @enemy{Meng Hua}.

achievements.description: Defeat three optional bosses in Meigu Lake.
achievements.summary: Beat three optional Meigu Lake bosses: the One-Eyed Archer, Yan Qiansui and You Loong.

steps.text: Sail to the Blackwater camp on the lake and beat @enemy{You Loong}, who is called the Frenzied Blackwater Crew Leader there. The Pangzhen fight does not count.
Sail from the @loc{Pangzhen Docks} to the @loc{Meigu Songhouse} Dock island and defeat @enemy{Yan Qiansui}.
Sail north-east from the @loc{White Serpent House} Dock to the @loc{One-Eyed Isle} and defeat the @enemy{One-Eyed Archer}.

achievements.description: Defeat the four Great Puppets.
achievements.summary: Beat Yucong, Yuding, Yubi and Yuzan, the four Great Puppets.

guide.context: Yuzan and Yuding are story bosses. Yubi and Yucong are optional.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Yuzan}, the No. 3 Musician Puppet, at the end of @loc{Village of Lu}.
Beat @enemy{Yubi}, the No. 21 Swordfighter Puppet who guards the end of @loc{Mandate Encampment}.
Beat @enemy{Yuding}, the No. 12 Crescent Blade Puppet, midway through @loc{Mirage Estate}, near the Training Grounds.
Begin the Triple Threat tale early: step into the statue beside The Lady's Rift Bell in @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}. Its boss, @enemy{Yucong}, is too strong at that point.
After Mirage Estate, cross the frozen lake in @loc{Crimson Forest} to the @loc{Threadbound Great Tree} and beat @enemy{Yucong}, the No. 34 Twisted Puppet.
steps.note: Blazing Edge (Sanguine Reach tempered with Scorching Flames and Quenched Flaming Grip) triggers his last phase, which the tale reward needs.

achievements.description: Defeat two optional blade masters.
achievements.summary: Take down Commander Bi Feng and Zhu Yuan.

guide.context: Both are optional bosses, and the true ending needs both.

steps.text: From the @loc{Pangzhen Docks}, walk east along the docks to the Sha-Chi Tower. Lure the explosive enemy to the cage in the first-floor room, go down the elevator and defeat @enemy{Zhu Yuan}.
In the @loc{Mountain of Imprisonment}, defeat @enemy{Bi Feng} midway along the route.

achievements.description: Defeat the three Shadow Wardens.
achievements.summary: Beat the Shadow Wardens Cavalrybane, Soulclaimer and Heartpiercer.

guide.context: All three are story bosses.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Cavalrybane} midway through @loc{Pangzhen}.
Defeat @enemy{Soulclaimer} by the entrance to @loc{Meigu Lake}.
Open the @loc{White Serpent House} in @loc{Meigu Lake} with the Loong Emblem and defeat @enemy{Heartpiercer}.

achievements.description: Complete [Secrets at the Heart of the Lake]
achievements.summary: Finish the lake tale named Secrets at the Heart.

guide.context: The true ending depends on this tale, and entering Mirage Estate closes it. Finish it earlier and keep a manual save.

steps.text: In @loc{Village of Lu}, pick up a Firefly's Memory Flower to accept the tale, then collect all 6 Firefly petals.
Step into the fog beside the @loc{Temple of Blue Fireflies} and beat @enemy{Dusk, The Puppeteer} in the ravine past it.
Win the scarecrow fights in @loc{Village of Lu}, @loc{Pangzhen} and @loc{Meigu Lake} for three Acolyte Masks.
Enter the Herald's Illusion portals in @loc{Village of Lu}, @loc{Mandate Encampment} and the @loc{Mountain of Imprisonment}. The last one gives the @item{Puppet's Tongue} and the Yin eye.
With the tongue, enter the @loc{Crimson Manor} in @loc{Weeping Creek Valley} and defeat the @enemy{Puppet Scavenger} and @enemy{Acolyte Hansui} for the Yang eye and the fourth mask.
In the snowy west of @loc{Meigu Lake}, use the four masks on the mirror, cross the ruins and defeat the @enemy{Blizzard Blademaster}.
Put both eyes into the red statue behind his arena, enter the hidden realm, defeat the elders and talk to @npc{Inanis}.

achievements.description: Complete [Bloodline Awakening]
achievements.summary: Complete the tale Bloodline Awakening by winning all five Long Pillar fights.

guide.context: The tale starts when you find your first Long Pillar. The five fights always come in the same order, whichever pillar you use first. The fifth win gives the Bastion of Mo Mask. The last pillar opens only after Mirage Estate and must be done before the final area.

collectibles.name: Weeping Creek Valley pillar
collectibles.location: Next to the @loc{Weeping Creek Long Pillar} Bell
collectibles.method: Interact with the pillar and win the duel. The first fight is hard, so you can come back later.

collectibles.name: Crimson Forest pillar
collectibles.location: Next to the @loc{Mirrorwood Long Pillar} Bell
collectibles.method: Interact with the pillar and win the duel.

collectibles.name: Meigu Lake east pillar
collectibles.location: Next to the @loc{Midlake Long Pillar} Bell
collectibles.method: Sail east along the cliffs from the @loc{Lake Banyan Dock}, follow the orange lanterns into the cave, dock, then interact with the pillar.

collectibles.name: Phantom Illusionist Ruins pillar
collectibles.location: Near the third bell in the @loc{Phantom Illusionist Ruins}
collectibles.method: Break the barricade at the third ruins bell and interact with the pillar on the left. The ruins need all four Acolyte Masks.

collectibles.name: Pangzhen pillar
collectibles.location: Next to the @loc{Mirage Estate Long Pillar} Bell
collectibles.method: Interact with the pillar after entering @loc{Mirage Estate}.

achievements.description: Complete [Secrets of the Baishan Sect]
achievements.summary: Complete the tale Secrets of the Baishan Sect.

guide.context: You must accept this tale before @enemy{Bai Chilian} falls. It also fails if you skip the body in the flowers before the last fight.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Lanlan} on the big bridge close to the @loc{Thieves' Camp} Bell in @loc{Crimson Forest}. Accept the tale before @enemy{Bai Chilian} falls. Save manually when each region starts and when it ends.
At the @loc{Cliffside Lodge} Bell, take the Crimson Forest Cellar Crank and use it to open the cellar.

Descend and land on the plank that sits between the two platforms. Grab the Crimson Forest Secret Chamber Crank, jump down to the lowest level, use the crank on the door, and speak with the girl in the room.
At The Confinement Bell in @loc{Mandate Encampment}, defeat @enemy{Wu Lengshuang} and follow the path up.
Check the body lying in the flowers before the next fight.
Beat @enemy{Yubi}, who stands at the region's far end. Once the fight is over, a cutscene finishes the tale.

achievements.description: Complete [The Journey Home]
achievements.summary: Complete the tale The Journey Home.

guide.context: You must go back to Old Man Gen after the Pangzhen door opens and before you enter Pangzhen.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Old Man Gen} next to the @loc{Old Man Gen's Hideout} Bell in @loc{Village of Lu}. Save manually when each region starts and when it ends.
Unlock the sealed door that closes off the region, go back to @npc{Old Man Gen} and take his request. Do this before you enter @loc{Pangzhen}.
In @loc{Pangzhen}, rest at the @loc{Pond of Fading Song} Bell and face the other way. Take the right-hand path and set the branches on fire with @item{Flaming Mane}.
Follow the route to @loc{Old Man Gen's House}, open its door and examine the body inside.
Return to @npc{Old Man Gen} in @loc{Village of Lu} to finish the tale.
steps.note: Do this before you leave Meigu Lake.

achievements.description: Complete [Young Master Lan]
achievements.summary: Complete the tale Young Master Lan.

guide.context: You must go back to Young Master Lan after the Pangzhen door opens and before you enter Pangzhen.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Young Master Lan} at his hideout in @loc{Village of Lu}, where the bell is named @loc{Young Master Lan Hideout}. Save manually when each region starts and when it ends.
Open the sealed door that closes off the region, then return to him before you enter @loc{Pangzhen}.
In @loc{Pangzhen}, head for the @loc{Pavilion of Knowledge Crossroads}, then keep following the road. A cutscene hands you the Lan Manor Key.
Rest at any bell, return to the same spot, defeat the enemies and talk to him again.
Enter the manor. The cutscene completes the tale.

achievements.description: Complete [A Severed Mindseal]
achievements.summary: Complete the tale A Severed Mindseal.

guide.context: Do the first part before you leave Weeping Creek Valley. The last part opens only after Mirage Estate.

steps.text: In @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}, take the tale from the @npc{Shadow Warden} who stands at the summit bell of the @loc{Valley Sha-Chi Tower}. Save manually when each region starts and when it ends.

Climb down the large ladder close by and beat the enemy there for the Furnace Inspection Crank. Then open the furnace at the @loc{Tower 1st Floor} Bell with the crank, take the @item{Primal Stone} and hand it to the Warden. Keep the crank.

At the @loc{Pangzhen Docks}, walk east along the docks instead of boarding the boat, climb the @loc{Sha-Chi Tower} to the top and meet the Warden again. Use the crank on the furnace for another Primal Stone and give it to him.
steps.note: The furnace is past the giant wooden bridge from the Lower Exterior Bell.

steps.text: After Mirage Estate, cross the frozen water in the south-east of @loc{Crimson Forest} to the last Sha-Chi Tower. Climb to the top and give the Warden the last Primal Stone.

achievements.description: Complete [Flesh Lily], [Apprentice Healer], and [A Healer’s Mercy]
achievements.summary: Finish A Healer's Mercy, Apprentice Healer and Flesh Lily.

guide.context: All three are easy to fail. Each one fails when a specific boss falls.

steps.text: Take the @item{Twin Flesh Lilies} from @enemy{Hua, Deadly Betrothed}'s arena and give them to @npc{Yu'er} at the Outpost Bell before @enemy{Bai Chilian} falls.

After defeating @enemy{Peng Meng}, accept Apprentice Healer from @npc{Yu'er}. Gather the three herbs in the valley (Blood-Stopper Vine, Congealeaf and Blemish Goldweed) and bring them back before @enemy{Jing Ye} falls.
steps.note: Blood-Stopper Vine: river below the Axemaster's Holding Cell exit. Congealeaf: near the door opened by the Rusted Loong Key. Blemish Goldweed: end of the river past the Weeping Creek Valley Long Pillar.

steps.text: Accept A Healer's Mercy from @npc{Yu'er} at the @loc{Thieves' Camp} Bell in @loc{Crimson Forest}. Heal the four thieves and return to her before @enemy{Bai Chilian} falls.
steps.note: Thieves: two caves close to the Outlaw Trap Bell; the bottom of the giant ladder by the Cliffside Lodge Bell; and past the locked door in the Thieves' Camp, whose key lies under the lodge cellar.

steps.text: In @loc{Pangzhen}, after defeating @enemy{Chang Hong}, enter @npc{Yu'er}'s home directly ahead and talk to the old man to use the Flesh Lily.

achievements.description: Complete All [Quick Hand’s Requests]
achievements.summary: Complete all of Quick Hand Zhang's requests.

guide.context: He has a hideout in each region he visits.

steps.text: Rescue @npc{Quick Hand Zhang} close to the @loc{Trail of Cages} Bell in @loc{Crimson Forest}. Then talk to him at his hideout by the @loc{Thieves' Camp} Bell to accept the request.
In each region below, find the treasures and give them to him at his hideout: Crimson Forest 3, Village of Lu 3, Pangzhen 4, Meigu Lake 4, Mirage Estate 3.
steps.note: Treasures: Crimson Forest - Sect Leader's Snuff Bottle, Bloodstained Seal, Ancient Crossbow. Village of Lu - Wedding Candles, Unveiled Statue, White Jade Twins. Pangzhen - Tiger Paperweight, Ink Stick, Carved-Edge Inkstone, Jade Brush Rest. Meigu Lake - Blue Blossom Compass, Blight Astrolabe, Sundial of Impermanence, plus one more. Mirage Estate - General's Bronze Mirror, Gold-and-Silver Sachet, Golden Cloud-Moon Hairpin.

steps.text: Finish by handing in the last set at @loc{Zhang's Hideout} in @loc{Mirage Estate}.

achievements.description: Complete [Heart of the Banyan]
achievements.summary: Complete the tale Heart of the Banyan by winning all five Banyan Tree challenges.

guide.context: The tale starts after your second meeting with the Illusion of Inanis. Each challenge is waves of enemies that end with a rematch against an earlier boss. If you die, you restart from the wave where you fell.

collectibles.name: Crimson Forest
collectibles.location: Past the @loc{Parting Mists} Bell, the giant tree on the right
collectibles.method: Interact with the tree. The last wave is a rematch with @enemy{Jing Ye}.

collectibles.name: Pangzhen
collectibles.location: Across the wooden path past the @enemy{You Loong} arena
collectibles.method: Interact with the tree. The last wave is a rematch with @enemy{Master Bi Yuan}.

collectibles.name: Mandate Encampment
collectibles.location: From the @loc{Sunset Path} Bell, up the stairs and grapple to the cliff on the right
collectibles.method: Interact with the tree. The last wave is a rematch with @enemy{Iron Fiend} and @enemy{Stone Hand Iron Fever}.

collectibles.name: Meigu Lake
collectibles.location: Straight ahead from the @loc{Lake Banyan Dock} Bell
collectibles.method: Interact with the tree. The last wave is a rematch with @enemy{Cavalrybane} and @enemy{Soulclaimer}.

collectibles.name: Mountain of Imprisonment
collectibles.location: Past the locked door and over the wooden bridge, starting at the @loc{Shrine Outer Gate} Bell
collectibles.method: Interact with the tree. The last wave is a rematch with @enemy{Iron Butcher} and @enemy{Jagged Steel}.

achievements.description: Perform Tempering on 10 weapons
achievements.summary: Perform Soul Tempering on 10 weapons.

guide.context: Each weapon can be tempered once. Tempering uses one material that fits that weapon plus 5,000 Remnant Dust, and it cannot be undone. Weapons and Phantom Edges are separate lists.

steps.text: Reach the Order's underground tavern in @loc{Pangzhen} and talk to @npc{Myst}.
Collect a weapon's Soul Tempering material. Several need a Phantom Edge to reach: @item{Tiger Cannon} breaks walls, the repaired Illusory Pipa clears fog, and @item{Flaming Mane} burns branches.
steps.note: Examples: Dancer's Ribbon for Soft Snake Sword, Bronze Essence for Tianxuan Bronze Sword, Embroidered Shoes for Scarlet Wraithblade, High-Power Pump for Loong Trident, Six Paths Warrant for Outlaw Warblade, Iron Butcher Mask for Jagged Steel.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Myst}, choose Soul Temper, select the weapon, and pay the material and 5,000 Remnant Dust. Repeat until 10 weapons are done.

achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon to Level 30
achievements.summary: Upgrade a weapon to level 30.

guide.context: Upgrades can be refunded, so you can test weapons without losing materials.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Forge} at the @loc{Outpost} in @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}.
At any bell, open the upgrade menu and spend upgrade materials on one weapon until it reaches level 30.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Sha-Chi Ambers
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Sha-Chi Ambers.

guide.context: Four Sha-Chi Amber Fragments make one Amber, so you need 40 fragments. They come from chests and defeated enemies. The count shows in the skill tree.

steps.text: Open chests and defeat marked enemies in each region and pick up every Sha-Chi Amber Fragment. The game holds 40 in total, so take every one you see.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Memory Flowers
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Memory Flowers.

guide.context: A Memory Flower is a group of 2 to 6 petals. The flower counts once you hold all of its petals.

steps.text: Pick up the blue flower petals you see around the world until 10 flowers are complete. @loc{Village of Lu} has many petals.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Blackstones
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Blackstones.

guide.context: Four Blackstone Fragments make one Blackstone, so you need 40 fragments. The count shows in the skill tree.

steps.text: Open chests and defeat marked enemies in each region and pick up every Blackstone Fragment. The game holds 40 in total, so take every one you see.

achievements.description: Collect 30 Accessories
achievements.summary: Collect 30 accessories.

guide.context: The game has over 60 accessories, so missing a few missable ones does not matter.

steps.text: Pick up accessories from chests, enemy drops and tale rewards until you own 30.

achievements.description: Perform Tempering on 10 Phantom Edges
achievements.summary: Perform Soul Tempering on 10 Phantom Edges.

guide.context: Each Phantom Edge can be tempered once. Tempering uses one material that fits that edge plus 5,000 Remnant Dust, and it cannot be undone.

steps.text: Reach the Order's underground tavern in @loc{Pangzhen} and talk to @npc{Myst}.

Collect a Phantom Edge's Soul Tempering material. Several need a Phantom Edge to reach: @item{Tiger Cannon} breaks walls, @item{Bashpole} breaks cracked ground, and @item{Flaming Mane} burns branches.
steps.note: Examples: Pigeon Feed for Bashpole, Border Banner for Bastion, Border Poems for Wolfjaw, Thunder Core for Thunder Spear, Reinforced Bowstring for Feather Bow, Golden Ammunition for Tiger Cannon.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Myst}, choose Soul Temper, switch to Phantom Edges, select one, and pay the material and 5,000 Remnant Dust. Repeat until 10 are done.

achievements.description: Upgrade a Phantom Edge to Level 30
achievements.summary: Raise a Phantom Edge to level 30.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Forge} at the @loc{Outpost} in @loc{Weeping Creek Valley}.
At any bell, open the upgrade menu and spend upgrade materials on one Phantom Edge until it reaches level 30.

achievements.description: Perform a Chain Assassination
achievements.summary: Perform a Chain Assassination.

steps.text: Sneak up on an unaware enemy and assassinate them, then use the chain prompt on a second unaware enemy nearby.

achievements.description: Perform a Chain Execution
achievements.summary: Perform a Chain Execution.

steps.text: Break an enemy's stagger gauge and execute them, then use the chain prompt on another enemy nearby.

achievements.description: Inflict Blood Loss with Jagged Steel
achievements.summary: Inflict Blood Loss with the Jagged Steel.

guide.context: Puppets, golden bodies and phantom bodies cannot bleed.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Jagged Steel, The Frenzied Brute} near the @loc{Rustblade Pavilion} to earn the weapon.
Equip it and keep hitting one living enemy until its bleed gauge fills.

achievements.description: Use Fanatic's Broken Blade to enter the [Drunk] State
achievements.summary: Get into the Drunk state with the Fanatic's Broken Blade.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hua Qianxiao} (see A Thousand Cups Drained) to get the weapon.
Equip it, then press block and heavy attack together to drink and become tipsy.
Spend one full bar of Sha-Chi Essence on the weapon art to enter the Drunk state.

achievements.description: Use Soft Snake Sword's [Serpentine Reversal] to deflect an enemy attack
achievements.summary: Deflect an enemy attack with the Soft Snake Sword's Serpentine Reversal.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Wu Lengshuang} in @loc{Mandate Encampment} to get the weapon.
Equip it and press block and heavy attack together just as an enemy attack is about to land.

achievements.description: Use Infernal Rouge to unleash [Phantom Blade]
achievements.summary: Unleash Phantom Blade with the Infernal Rouge.

guide.context: Infernal Rouge is Sanguine, your starting sword, after Soul Tempering. Phantom Blade takes 2 bars of Sha-Chi Essence.

steps.text: Win all five Long Pillar fights to get the @item{Bastion of Mo Mask}. The last one is in @loc{Mirage Estate}.
At @loc{Pangzhen}, pay @npc{Myst} 5,000 Remnant Dust and hand over Sanguine and the mask to Soul Temper it into Infernal Rouge.
In a fight with 2 bars of Sha-Chi Essence, use Power Surge to enter Bloodline Awakening.
While it lasts (10 seconds), press Power Surge again to unleash Phantom Blade.

achievements.description: Use Outlaw's Warblade to unleash [Bloodthirst Frenzy]
achievements.summary: Unleash Bloodthirst Frenzy with the Outlaw's Warblade.

guide.context: Puppets, golden bodies and phantom bodies cannot be drained.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Jing Ye, The Outlaw} in @loc{Crimson Forest} to get the weapon.
Equip it and use its weapon art on a living enemy.

achievements.description: Use Whiteshadow to freeze an enemy
achievements.summary: Freeze an enemy with the Whiteshadow.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Blizzard Blademaster} (see The White Shadow) to get the weapon.
Equip it and keep hitting one enemy to fill its freeze gauge. Hitting an enemy with its weapon art also freezes it.

achievements.description: Use Crescent Blade's [Qinglong Cleave] to instantly kill an enemy
achievements.summary: Instantly kill an enemy with the Crescent Blade's Qinglong Cleave.

guide.context: Use it on a weaker enemy, not a boss.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Yuding} in @loc{Mirage Estate} to get the weapon.
Equip it and hold block and heavy attack to charge until the Azure Dragon possession starts.
Press heavy attack to use Qinglong Cleave on a weaker enemy.

achievements.description: Use Fiend Saws to trigger [Fiend-Aura Erosion]
achievements.summary: Trigger Fiend-Aura Erosion with the Fiend Saws.

guide.context: The Fiend Saws only drop if you finish the Young Mistress tale before you fight Mu Xiaokui. If you defeat her without it, they are lost for this playthrough.

steps.text: Collect all five red headbands in @loc{Village of Lu} before taking the lift to the final boss. Save manually when each region starts and when it ends.

Locations: the tree past @enemy{Zhou Bi}'s arena; a tree standing beside the bell of the @loc{Temple of Blue Fireflies}; a post midway over the bridge starting at the @loc{Covered Bridge} Bell; the headband you receive by resting at @loc{The Lady Grounds} Bell; and a post on the bridge reached from the @loc{Beneath the Well} Bell.
Defeat @enemy{Mu Xiaokui}, including her extra last phase, to get the @item{Fiend Saws}.
Equip them and keep hitting one enemy until Fiend-Aura Erosion builds up and erupts by itself.

achievements.description: Use Seamless Death to land consecutive Flying Rings on a locked-on enemy
achievements.summary: Hit a locked-on enemy with consecutive Flying Rings from the Seamless Death.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Jade-Face} in the @loc{Mountain of Imprisonment} to get the weapon.
Equip it, lock on to an enemy, and use its weapon art Endless Ring of Death so several Flying Rings in a row hit the target.

achievements.description: Use Baishan Stormsword to unleash [Lightning Storm]
achievements.summary: Unleash Lightning Storm with the Baishan Stormsword.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Yubi} in @loc{Mandate Encampment} to get the weapon.
Equip it. Normal combos build wind and Sha-Chi combos build thunder.
When both are full, the Baishan's Blessing begins. Press block and heavy attack within 20 seconds to unleash Lightning Storm.

achievements.description: Use Bashpole to land an aerial slam on an enemy
achievements.summary: Hit an enemy with an aerial slam from the Bashpole.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Wan Jun, The Coppermaul} in @loc{Mandate Encampment} to get the @item{Bashpole}.
Equip it and, while airborne, come down on an enemy with a slam.

achievements.description: Defeat a Blackwater boss twice.
achievements.summary: Beat You Loong, the Blackwater Crew's leader, two times: first in Pangzhen, then at Meigu Lake.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{You Loong} in @loc{Pangzhen}, in the arena down the stairs below the Green Serpent House area.
Defeat the Frenzied Blackwater Crew Leader @enemy{You Loong} at the Blackwater camp in @loc{Meigu Lake}.

achievements.description: Use Iron Gauntlets to perform [Masterstroke Fist]
achievements.summary: Perform Masterstroke Fist with the Iron Gauntlets.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Stone Hand Iron Fever} near the Mirrorwood entrance in @loc{Crimson Forest} to get the weapon.
Upgrade the gauntlets to level 5 and equip them.
Hold the Phantom Edge button to charge and release the moment the gauntlets flash to perform Masterstroke Fist.

achievements.description: Use Thunder Spear to paralyze an enemy
achievements.summary: Paralyze an enemy with the Thunder Spear.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Chang Hong, The Thunder Spear} in @loc{Pangzhen} to get the weapon.
Equip it and keep hitting one enemy until the shock builds up and paralyzes it.

achievements.description: Use any Summon-type Phantom Edge to summon an ally
achievements.summary: Summon an ally with any Summon-type Phantom Edge.

steps.text: Get a Summon Phantom Edge: Swordsman's Summon from the Chief Disciple in @loc{Mandate Encampment}, or Puppeteer's Bell from @enemy{Dusk, The Puppeteer} in @loc{Village of Lu}.
steps.note: Dusk's ravine opens only after you clear the fog at the Temple of Blue Fireflies, which needs all 6 Firefly petals.

steps.text: Equip it and use it in a fight to call in an ally.

achievements.description: Unlock all other achievements
achievements.summary: Unlock all 65 other achievements.

steps.text: Earn every other achievement in the list. It unlocks on its own.
